subject: SIG: evidence matrix & delivery timeline for Finera (deadline Oct 11)
thread_text:
From: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@finera.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finera.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Finera questionnaire and deadline Oct 11

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our SIG export (Finera_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) — we need the completed questionnaire and supporting evidence by end of day Oct 11 so our InfoSec team can finish review.

Key asks:
- Questions completed in the XLS (column for answers + reference link)
- Evidence files organized by control (screenshots, logs, policy PDFs)
- A short evidence matrix (where each artifact maps to SIG question)

Can you confirm who will own the sections and whether you can meet Oct 11? Drive upload is preferred for large files.

Cheers,
Chris Dalton
Senior Security Manager
Finera

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@finera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Finera questionnaire and deadline Oct 11

Hi Chris — thanks for sending and for the clear deadline. We can commit to working toward Oct 11 but I want to propose an internal milestones plan so we hit it without last-minute churn.

Plan (proposed):
- Oct 2: draft answers for all questionnaire items (internal review)
- Oct 5: evidence collection in Drive (placeholders for any items pending)
- Oct 8: internal sign-off and gap log
- Oct 11: final upload to your Drive link

I've looped in Monica (Security Ops lead) to assign owners. Monica — can you coordinate evidence owners and share a Drive folder link? We'll send weekly status updates every Fri until delivery.

Tessa Morgan
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0128

Attachment: Finera_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx

---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Finera SIG — owners and immediate asks

Tessa / team,

Per Tessa's note — I'll own coordination. Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Infrastructure & network (VPC, subnets, firewall rules): Rishi Malhotra
- Application & secrets handling (runtime secrets, KMS): Dev Patel
- Policies & SOC artifacts (policies, SOC 2 evidence crosswalk): Monica Patel

Immediate asks:
- Rishi: export IAM screenshots, network diagrams, and a sample audit log by Oct 5
- Dev: run a short script to pull service account lists and rotation configs; upload by Oct 5
- Monica: prepare policy PDFs and the policy-to-SIG mapping (I'll draft the mapping template)

I'll create the Drive folder today and populate the evidence_matrix template. Use naming convention: REDWOOD_FINERA_SIG_<owner>_<YYYYMMDD>.<ext>

Thanks — Monica

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Finera SIG — owners and immediate asks

Sounds good — I'll take infra. Plan:
- 10/02 morning: export VPC/network diagram and attach firewall rule summary
- 10/04: provide sample IAM screenshots (admin list + example user permissions)

Question: do we want compressed evidence packs per control or a single zip per owner? I prefer per-owner zips for clarity (easier to track). Example naming: REDWOOD_SIG_20261004_INFRA.zip

-Rishi

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@finera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: evidence matrix & delivery timeline for Finera (deadline Oct 11)

Hi Chris — quick status update:
- Draft answers: ~85% complete (internal review in progress)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/finera-sig-evidence (placeholder, will populate by Oct 5)
- Evidence plan: per-owner zips + an evidence matrix mapping each artifact to the SIG question number

One question for your team: do you prefer we upload directly to your Drive folder or share a transfer S3 link? You mentioned Drive earlier — we'll use that unless you prefer otherwise.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@finera.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@finera.com>, security@finera.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: evidence matrix & delivery timeline for Finera (deadline Oct 11)

Thanks Tessa — Drive is preferred. Two additional asks from our InfoSec team:
1) Organization chart (org chart PDF)
2) IAM admin-role screenshots (for the management console)

If you can get those by Oct 8 that will help speed internal review. I'll add Alyssa from our compliance team to coordinate.

-Chris

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: evidence matrix & delivery timeline for Finera (deadline Oct 11)

Team — final nudge before week of delivery. Action items and owners with due dates:
- Monica: policy PDFs + policy-to-SIG mapping (due Oct 05)
- Rishi: IAM screenshots + network diagram (due Oct 04 end of day — please upload now if ready)
- Dev: service account list and rotation configs (due Oct 05)

Notes:
- Use the Drive link Chris expects. Drop files in /Finera_SIG/owner_name/ and add a single REDWOOD_SIG_FINAL_INDEX.xlsx that maps artifacts to SIG IDs.
- If anything is blocked, flag it here and I'll escalate to Chris (we should avoid missing Oct 11).

I'll compile the evidence pack and run a final QA pass Oct 08–09.

Thanks — Tessa
